# CurveScout

> Free motorcycle route planner and ride library. Rides are measured on stored roads built from OpenStreetMap data, with stops, height profiles, riding time and plain notes on the roads. No account needed.

Facts about the site: made in Meilen, Switzerland; free to use; 1,172 rides rated best in 93 countries (see the open table below); every ride page states where each number comes from (measured, recorded or estimated).

## Start here
- [Best motorcycle rides](https://curvescout.com/rides.html): featured rides by country
- [Ride library by country](https://curvescout.com/read/index.html): all ride records
- [Riding calendar](https://curvescout.com/calendar/): seasons, pass openings and access rules
- [Guides](https://curvescout.com/guides/): planning a motorcycle trip
- [How the evidence works](https://curvescout.com/how-curvescout-works.html)
- [Sources and coverage](https://curvescout.com/sources-and-coverage.html)
- [Press, citation and reuse](https://curvescout.com/press.html)

## Terms of use
You may read, summarise and cite CurveScout pages with a link. Training AI models on CurveScout content or copying the ride collection needs written permission: https://curvescout.com/legal.html#use
